english.note: Use 帶 as the all-purpose verb for taking something with you or having it on your person.
Use this as the all-purpose verb for carrying or bringing something, including carrying weapons or symbols.

examples.english: I always carry an umbrella when I go out.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ceot1 gaai1 jat1 ding6 daai3 ze1

examples.english: They bear arms while serving in the military.
examples.traditional: 佢哋服兵役嗰陣會帶武器。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 fuk6 bing1 jik6 go2 zan6 wui5 daai3 mou5 hei3

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for leading or directing people or tasks.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice for taking or guiding someone somewhere, guiding them toward an answer, leading a group, or describing a route that takes you somewhere.

examples.english: I conduct the whole team as we complete this task.
examples.traditional: 我帶住成隊人完成呢項任務。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 daai3 zyu6 seng4 deoi6 jan4 jyun4 sing4 ni1 hong6 jam6 mou6

examples.english: Please lead me to the MTR station.
examples.jyutping: nei5 daai3 ngo5 heoi3 dei6 tit3 zaam6 laa1
